Hi All,


I am employing a standard distance sampling approach to estimate guanaco abundance in a southern Chile population. When I apply "convert units = 0.1”, my covered area is reduced to what appear to be reasonable figures - 30% coverage of an east polygon (low guanaco abundance) and 45% coverage of a west polygon (high guanaco abundance). messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] unreasonably high estimates obtained, potential units issue
parts:
Matthew

Start from first principles.  Convert units is intended to standardise the units with which perpendicular distances, transect lengths and study area size are measured.

If you know the units with which each are measured, you can simply insert the units into the function convert_units()  available in the most recent version of Distance

remotes::install_github("DistanceDevelopment/Distance")
